title: Music Songs: tick up to 15 songs in the list, then create a class from them
acceptance: On Music › Songs the list is always in pick mode: tapping a song row toggles its selection, and the row never starts playback. Each row holds one <label> (song text and artwork) for its checkbox, so a tap or click toggles exactly once. The <label> sits inside the <li data-build-class-slot="song"> (the slot is an attribute on the row, not a control); any control that later mounts in that slot, and the RF-172 ▶ preview, sits beside the label, never inside it, so axe finds no nested interactive controls. Until RF-172 ships, tapping the artwork toggles the row like the rest of it.
At most 15 songs can be selected. At 15, unselected rows (checkbox and row tap alike) are disabled with a short note saying why; selected rows can still be unticked.
A selection bar shows "N of 15 selected", a way to clear the selection, and a "Create a class" button once at least one song is selected.
The selection survives search, Load more and sort changes within the same provider. Switching provider, disconnecting, or a different account's list clears it.

"Create a class" opens a short sheet that asks only for the class name and the template (Cycle, Pilates or HIIT), with the selected songs already chosen, then creates the class with those songs as its blocks. There is no second song picker.
The separate "Create class from liked songs" button and its song-picker step are removed from Music › Songs. Playlist import keeps its own flow.
It works the same for Apple Music and SoundCloud likes, at 1440 and 390 wide, with no horizontal overflow and axe WCAG 2.2 AA clean.

Component tests cover: one tap or click on a row toggles exactly once; a row tap never starts playback; selection; the 15 cap on both checkbox and row tap, with selected rows still untickable; persistence across Load more and search; clearing on provider switch; and the create sheet. The e2e smoke covers creating a class from selected songs.
After deploy, the owner smoke tests pick mode on Mac and iPhone and confirms the feel, or asks for the Spotify-style Select button instead.

Agent check (Neo) of #686 on production 67496ab (SPA assets/index-ChxMwIpX.js) in the owner's signed-in Mac Chrome at 1920 wide, saving nothing. Provider: Spotify likes only (RF-157 scope); Apple Music and SoundCloud were not checked. Seen: 200 liked songs; each row is one <label> with one checkbox and no other control, inside data-build-class-slot="song"; the old Create class from liked songs button is gone. One click on a title and one on an artwork each ticked once ("2 of 15 selected"); no audio, video or iframe appeared in the page, which does not rule out Spotify Connect playback on another device. Cap: after ticking rows 1-15, the 16th row's checkbox was disabled with the cap note, and unticking row 1 re-enabled it; other unticked rows were not inspected. The sheet asked only for a name ("Spotify likes") and a template; Cancel closed it, and Clear selection emptied the selection. Not checked: selection kept across search and Load more, clearing on provider switch, axe, creating a class, phone width and iPhone Safari. This does not satisfy acceptance item 9, the owner's own Mac and iPhone feel check.
